description: The last several weeks under the Gold Dome felt like the session really got into full swing. After the opening formalities, committees jumped into busy schedules, hearing from agencies and stakeholders. We also passed the state budget, carefully reviewing funding needs to make sure taxpayer dollars are spent wisely. It’s been a busy and productive stretch, and I’m grateful for…
